title: Session tab: a second client joins, waits on a card, you approve it, one seed
covers: Session tab lobby, LobbyMembers seat cards, JoinSession, Run in the tab
context: The seat grid of a session tab shows your own players and the players who connect with their own Archipelia. Here one app plays both parts: it hosts the session and joins it through Join a session. The joiner appears as a card with Approve and Refuse. Run in the tab makes one seed for both and opens the live room.
changed: views/LobbyMembers: member seat cards, admission states
views/SessionTabs: tab lobby and live room

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: one app
setup.text: The joining and the hosting happen in this one app. A second computer works the same way with the address.

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

steps: Open Sessions, New sess Name it Direct check, leave Where on Local, turn on Allow direct connections and then Allow unlisted clients (leave Hos Add a player Host1 with A Link to the Past and any pres Press The tab Direct check opens.
In the tab press the copy button of the session code. In the Network widget (left) copy the Lobby address. Run is enabled because Host1 is ready.
Open Sessions, press Join a session. Paste both and press Look at the session. A green line shows Direct check, its Archipelago version and Open for players.

Under Your player set Game to A Link to the Past, Options to Game defaults, Player name to Guest1 and Your name to Guest. Press Join as a player. Under Joined sessions the card reads Waiting for the host.

Go back to the tab Direct check. A new highlighted card for Guest shows Waiting for your approval, its game, the client facts and the tag unlisted, with the buttons Approve Guest and Refuse Guest. The Players heading counts 2.
Press Approve Guest. The card becomes a normal card with Remove and the slot Guest1 gets ready.
Press Run in the tab. The dot goes through Generating to Hosting and the cards give way to the live room. It shows the Address with its port, the Seed and two files, one for Host1 and one for Guest1.
Open Sessions, Join a session. The card for Direct check shows Room open with the Room address, On this computer, Slot, Game and Seed.
pass: The joiner appears as a highlighted card with Approve and Refuse, and Players counts both players.
Approve makes the card normal and the slot ready. Run is available before and after.
Run makes one seed that holds Host1 and Guest1, and the room shows its address, seed and two files.
The joiner card shows Room open with the same addresses.
fail: The joiner never appears, stays on Connecting, or shows a red error.
Approve is missing or greyed out, or the slot never gets ready.
Run fails, or only one player has a file.
The room address is missing in the tab or in the join card.
notes: Allow unlisted clients is required: Archipelia joins as an unlisted client. The test Join a session shows the message when it is off.
Optional: add a third player Guest1 with the Direct switch on and no game before Run. Its seat shows dashed as a held seat, and the card of the joiner named Guest1 takes its place.
The room, Stop and closing are in the test Live room. A second computer check is optional: use the test Where and LAN for the address.
